name: Bird and Kip
overview: "Bird and Kip" is an English graded animation series launched by Little Fox. The protagonists are a little bird named Bird and a chipmunk named Kip. The story revolves around the amusing incidents that occur in the daily lives of these two unlikely animal friends. Kip is a noisy, troublemaking new neighbor, while Bird prefers a quiet life. Their interactions are filled with humor and challenges.《小鸟与基普》讲述的是可爱的小捣蛋鬼基普和心地善良的小鸟之间的故事。
